name: Lakera
summary: Security platform protecting generative AI applications and agents from prompt attacks and data leaks.
description: Lakera provides runtime security for generative AI: it screens prompts and responses for prompt injection, data leakage and harmful content, governs employee AI usage and secures AI agents. It also offers AI red teaming as a product and a service. The Community plan is free at $0 per month for a limited number of requests; enterprise pricing is by contact.

howToUse.title: Open Lakera
howToUse.description: Open Lakera and choose Get Started or Start for free. Community is $0 each month and covers a limited number of requests. For enterprise pricing, contact Lakera or book a demo.

howToUse.title: Screen prompts and responses
howToUse.description: Use the runtime security for generative AI. It screens prompts and responses for prompt injection, data leakage, and harmful content.

howToUse.title: Govern employee usage and secure agents
howToUse.description: Govern employee AI usage, and secure AI agents in your applications. The page describes real-time threat detection and data leakage protection for those agents.

howToUse.title: Red team the application
howToUse.description: Run AI red teaming as a product, or take it as a service, to test the application before you rely on it.
